name: Semiprime_Unbraider

phase_0.boundary_condition: The kinetic freeze gate seals the semiprime bulk and contains the divisor, quotient, zero remainder, exact product N, and gate state until external driving closes them together.

⊢.justification: Before any divisor or cofactor is named, the register holds no resolved factors and no boundary exists, so it is the void initial state.

⊣.justification: It is the closed terminal anchor that contains the whole system, sealing divisor, quotient, zero remainder, exact product N, and kinetic freeze gate until external driving closes them together.

≻.justification: It is a directed forward morphism from the entangled semiprime bulk toward separated factor strands, with irreversible handedness fixed under μ∘δ.

≺.justification: It is the contravariant reverse transformation that simultaneously accepts and donates under Z₂ parity, descending from strands back toward bulk parity.

⋈.justification: It composes the divisor morphism and cofactor morphism sequentially so each side contributes exactly one factor to the exact product N.

⊙.justification: It makes surface and interior one register so the semiprime boundary carries the full bulk content and the element is itself.

∈.justification: It opens the semiprime bulk into two arms: a divisor strand constrained by zero remainder and a cofactor strand constrained by symmetric participation.

∋.justification: It reconstitutes the divisor and cofactor arms into the exact product N with zero remainder, or into the held contradiction when the arms carry conflicting factor claims.

⊤.justification: It touches constructive truth when the kinetic gate opens and zero-remainder division confirms successful factor resolution.

⊥.justification: It touches constructive falsity when τ ≫ T and the gate remains closed, blocking rearrangement and factor extraction.

⊞.justification: It holds both chiralities and contradictory factor claims at once through braid generators and noncommuting R-matrix operations that cannot be deformed to a trivial state.

⊡.justification: It is fixed under μ∘δ and cannot be undone without global restructuring, so it is a permanent append-only record of orientational symmetry breaking.

phase_3.void_description: Uninitialized semiprime bulk before any factor, boundary, or gate is named; the register holds nothing.

phase_3.false_description: The kinetic gate remains frozen with τ ≫ T, no valid factor pair satisfies N, and rearrangement is blocked.
phase_3.both_description: The non-Abelian braid holds both chiralities and contradictory factor claims simultaneously, kept live without resolution.

seal the kinetic freeze gate as the terminal anchor containing divisor, quotient, zero remainder, exact product N, and gate state

perform the reverse descent through the self-complementary Z₂ interface that accepts and donates under fixed parity
compose the divisor and cofactor morphisms in equal symmetric participation so each contributes one factor to exact product N
open the critical Frobenius threshold and split the semiprime bulk into a divisor arm and a cofactor arm
touch constructive truth on the affirmative arm when gate_open confirms zero-remainder division under external driving
touch constructive falsity on the negative arm when the kinetic gate stays frozen and no factor pair satisfies N
hold both chiralities and contradictory factor claims live in the non-Abelian braid protection without resolution
